findings.criterion: TERMINUS_3_AI_INSTRUCTIONS.md §4 Field rules tags **3-6**; §13 pre-submit checklist tags 3-6
findings.why_it_matters: tags is a required Edition 3 metadata field with an explicit 3-6 bound. Seven keywords (golang, sqlite, mvcc, cdc, wal, indexes, replica) exceed that contract and would fail a current metadata check even though taxonomy, timeouts, and artifacts are otherwise canonical.
findings.minimal_remediation: Keep three to six tags. Drop one redundant keyword (indexes or replica) without changing category/subcategory.
findings.regression_risk: Low; tag list is not solver-visible.

findings.criterion: TERMINUS_3_AI_INSTRUCTIONS.md §7 Pin language deps with lockfiles / go.sum; RC-ENV-003 Non-apt dependencies are pinned — High
findings.why_it_matters: The agent module requires modernc.org/sqlite v1.37.0 but ships no go.sum. Image build runs go mod tidy, so transitive checksums exist only after a network fetch inside Docker. Verifier pip is locked; the Go third-party graph is not. High review/CI pin rules treat that as a must-revise environment defect.
findings.minimal_remediation: Commit environment/catalog/go.sum generated from the pinned module, then build with go mod download and go build -mod=readonly. Do not rely on tidy to invent the lockfile at image build.
findings.regression_risk: Low if the committed sum matches v1.37.0; rebuild the agent image once.

findings.criterion: TERMINUS_3_AI_INSTRUCTIONS.md §7 Add OCI audit labels where practical
findings.why_it_matters: title/description/version/licenses are present; source/revision/created are omitted. The rule is practical, not mandatory.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: add org.opencontainers.image.source, .revision, and .created when those values are known.
